import zipfile, pathlib
archive = pathlib.Path('/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78549880/inputs/dataset_8c0e2a96-ef92-4892-a640-78a0a65823b0.dat')
out = pathlib.Path('busco_downloads')

with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:

PY

busco -i "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78549880/inputs/dataset_0fd62599-5d0c-4c2e-a858-926793d75493.dat" -m proteins -l eukaryota_odb10 --offline --download_path busco_downloads -o Fungi_Scer --out_path busco_runs -c 4
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
samples = ['Animals_Cele', 'Animals_Ggal', 'Fungi_Ncra', 'Fungi_Scer']
sets = []
lines = ['sample\tcomplete_single_copy_count\n']
for sample in samples:
    matches = list(Path('busco_runs').glob(f'{sample}/run_eukaryota_odb10/full_table.tsv'))
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'Expected one full_table.tsv for {sample}, found {len(matches)}')
    ids = set()
    with matches[0].open() as handle:
        for line in handle:
            if not line.strip() or line.startswith('#'):
                continue
            fields = line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
            if len(fields) >= 2 and fields[1] == 'Complete':
                ids.add(fields[0])
    sets.append(ids)
    lines.append(f'{sample}\t{len(ids)}\n')
common = set.intersection(*sets)
Path('per_sample_complete_single_copy_counts.tsv').write_text(''.join(lines))
Path('common_complete_single_copy_buscos.txt').write_text('\n'.join(sorted(common)) + ('\n' if common else ''))
Path('answer.txt').write_text(str(len(common)) + '\n')
PY
